# Goals

En este archivo realizaremos el análisis composicional de nuestro dataset de hongos (ITS) normalizado/escalado en la piel de ranas:

1. Cargar el objeto `phyloseq` escalado (`data/its/05_Ordination/scaled_physeq.RData`).
2. Calcular las abundancias relativas de los grupos taxonómicos en tres niveles:
    A. **Phylum**
    B. **Genus**
    C. **ASV**
3. Graficar los grupos principales y explorar cómo varían según la **localidad** (`localidad`, variable categórica) y la **altura desde el suelo** (`posicion_vertical_cm`, variable continua).

## Inputs 

1. Cargaremos `data/its/05_Ordination/scaled_physeq.RData`, creado en `analysis/05_Ordination/05_Ordination.Rmd`.

## Outputs 

1. Visualizaciones de la composición taxonómica fúngica y cómo varía a través de las localidades y la posición vertical.
2. Pruebas estadísticas exploratorias (Kruskal-Wallis / correlaciones) sobre grupos de interés.

# Compositional Data 

Microbial abundance data—like 16S rRNA gene, ITS, or metagenomics data—are typically **compositional:** they represent relative abundances constrained to a constant total (*e.g.,* percent or proportions). This introduces spurious correlations and other issues if analyzed with traditional statistics. This is a very important limitation to microbial data! 

<span style="color: red;">INTERPRETATION #1: What are the limitations of interpreting microbial abundance from relative (aka. compositional) rather than absolute counts?</span>

The limitations of relative abundance lie in the interpretation of change: because relative abundances are constrained to a sum of 100% (or 1.0) in each sample, if one fungal taxon increases in absolute abundance, it mathematically forces other taxa to decrease their relative percentage even if their actual cell/spore load on the frog skin did not change.

# Taxonomic Analysis

## A. Phylum

```{r calc-phylum-df}
# Create a phylum level dataframe
phylum_df <- 
  scaled_physeq %>%
  # Agglomerate all ASV counts within a phylum
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Phylum") %>%
  # Calculate the relative abundance! 
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) {x/sum(x)}) %>%
  # Create a dataframe from phyloseq object
  psmelt() 

## What are the phylum abundances? 
phylum_df %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarize(mean_PercAbund = round(mean(Abundance), digits = 4)) %>%
  arrange(-mean_PercAbund) %>%
  datatable()

# Make a list of the top 10 phyla 
top10_phyla <- 
  phylum_df %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarize(mean_PercAbund = mean(Abundance)) %>%
  arrange(-mean_PercAbund) %>%
  head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Phylum)

top10_phyla
```

<span style="color: red;">INTERPRETATION #2: Which phyla in your dataset have the highest relative abundances? What are their abundances? We will focus on these phyla for plotting below. :)</span>


## Stacked Bar Plots (Por Muestra y por Localidad)

```{r phylum-stacked-bar, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}
# 1. Stacked Bar Plot por muestra individual, agrupado por localidad
phylum_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum %in% top10_phyla) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_names, y = Abundance, fill = Phylum)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) + 
  facet_grid(. ~ localidad, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") + 
  labs(title = "Top 10 Fungal Phyla por muestra y localidad",
       x = "Muestra", y = "Relative Abundance") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 7),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 7))
```

## Faceted Bar Plot & Boxplot por Phylum y Localidad

```{r phylum-facet-bar, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
# Vista en barras facetadas por Phylum y Localidad
phylum_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum %in% top10_phyla) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_names, y = Abundance, fill = Phylum)) + 
  facet_grid(Phylum ~ localidad, scales = "free") + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(x = "Muestra", y = "Relative Abundance") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 6),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 7))
```

```{r plot-phylum-localidad, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
### Boxplots + Jitter de los Top 10 Phyla comparando entre localidades
phylum_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum %in% top10_phyla) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = localidad, y = Abundance, fill = localidad, color = localidad)) + 
  facet_wrap(Phylum ~ ., scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.4) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = localidad_colors) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = localidad_colors) + 
  labs(title = "Abundancia relativa de los Top 10 Phyla por Localidad",
       x = NULL, y = "Relative Abundance") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```

### A1. `p__Ascomycota` (Localidad y Posición Vertical)

```{r phylum-ascomycota, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
# CATEGÓRICA: Localidad
ascomycota_phylum_loc <- 
  phylum_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum == "p__Ascomycota") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = localidad, y = Abundance, 
             fill = localidad, color = localidad)) + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA) + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2) + 
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "bottom", size = 3) +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(title = "Ascomycota: Localidad", x = NULL, y = "Relative Abundance") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = localidad_colors) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = localidad_colors) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right")

# CONTINUA: posicion_vertical_cm
ascomycota_phylum_altura <- 
  phylum_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum == "p__Ascomycota") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = posicion_vertical_cm, y = Abundance)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = localidad), size = 2.5) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = TRUE) + 
  stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "bottom", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Ascomycota: Altura", x = "Posición vertical (cm)", y = "Relative Abundance") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = localidad_colors) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Combinar ambos gráficos
ascomycota_phylum_loc + ascomycota_phylum_altura + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
```

## B. Genus

Calculamos el dataframe aglomerado a nivel de género (`Genus`).

```{r genus-df}
# Calculate the Genus relative abundance 
genus_df <- 
  scaled_physeq %>%
  # agglomerate at the genus level 
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Genus") %>% 
  # Transform counts to relative abundance 
  transform_sample_counts(function (x) {x/sum(x)}) %>%
  # Melt to a long format 
  psmelt()

# Revisar los 10 géneros más abundantes en todo el dataset
top10_genera <- 
  genus_df %>%
  group_by(Phylum, Genus) %>%
  summarize(mean_PercAbund = round(mean(Abundance), digits = 4), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(-mean_PercAbund)

top10_genera %>% datatable()
```

### B1. Géneros principales de `p__Ascomycota`

```{r ascomycota-genus, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}

  head(n = 4) %>%

# Categórica: Localidad

  genus_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Genus %in% top_asco_genera) %>%

             fill = localidad, color = localidad)) +

  scale_color_manual(values = localidad_colors) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = localidad_colors) +

        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right")

# Continua: Posición vertical
asco_genus_altura <- 
  genus_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Genus %in% top_asco_genera) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = posicion_vertical_cm, y = Abundance)) + 
  facet_wrap(. ~ Genus, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = localidad), size = 2) +  
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = FALSE) + 
  labs(title = "Top 4 Ascomycota Genera vs Posición Vertical", x = "Posición vertical (cm)", y = "Relative Abundance") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = localidad_colors) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Combinar
asco_genus_loc / asco_genus_altura + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
```

## C. ASV level

```{r ASV-plots}
# Calculate the ASV relative abundance 
# Filtramos ASVs muy raros (quedándonos con aquellos que sumen al menos el ~1% de la profundidad escalada en todo el dataset)
umbral_conteos <- round(min(sample_sums(scaled_physeq)) * 0.05)

ASV_df <- 
  scaled_physeq %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) >= umbral_conteos, .) %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "ASV") %>% 
  transform_sample_counts(function (x) {x/sum(x)}) %>%
  psmelt()

# Ver cuáles son los 10 ASVs más abundantes globalmente
ASV_df %>%
  group_by(ASV, Phylum, Genus, Species) %>%
  summarize(mean_Abundance = round(mean(Abundance), 4), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(-mean_Abundance) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  datatable()
```
